mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates growing demand in the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity expands.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings expectations improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a 3-month period, it signals strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenues and earnings improve.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) for two consecutive months, it signals a real tightening of monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
